business.name: Hampton Inn & Suites New Orleans Downtown

ranking.name: Hampton Inn & Suites New Orleans Downtown

text.text_excerpt: My wife and I stayed at the Hampton Inn for 4 nights and enjoyed our stay. The room was nice and spacious and has a great location very close to Canal Street, good food options, and in walking distance to the French Quarter tourist spots. It is also really close to Bourbon Street but not so close that the noise radiating from that street it going to ruin your sleep quality. The hotel desk clerk Paige was very friendly and along with her coworker seemed to really enjoy her job. She was very enthusiastic when it came to recommending places for us to eat and things for us to do. We ended up eating at 3 out of the 5 suggestions she gave us. All were really good. Great stay in New Orleans. Cle...

This was a wonderful hotel. It's close enough to the French Quarter for you to easily get to, but far enough so you can get a good night's sleep. Also, the rooms are huge! I was super impressed with everything. My husband did say the breakfast was not the greatest but we are in New Orleans where there is great food all around so I didn't mind. They were also very nice to let us keep our carry ons stashed away until we had to go to the airport. Overall, great hotel at a great location.

Spacious, clean, comfortable, safe, with a nice view...yes I'm talking about the hotel rooms! Hampton Inn has done it again! They provided a great hotel room. It had huge high ceilings, the pictures don't do them justice. In fact I think this hotel had the highest ceilings I've ever seen in a hotel room. The room had a nice view, very clean, and had friendly staff throughout the hotel. It's in a perfect location for Mardi Gras whether you are there to party or to enjoy the city. When I checked in they gave me a Mardi Gras bag , 4 cups and beads. I loved it! Also because I'm a Hilton member I got a free snack and drink... food always makes me happy.
